posts.title: Being sincere in alt-rock
posts.description: I’ve spent twenty years following indie, alt-rock, shoegaze, metal, post-punk, post-rock and all the rest. And I’ve realized how sad it makes me to watch these musicians keep changing. I feel a lot closer to Bruce Springsteen than to Eddie Vedder. Bruce has always been Bruce. posts.title: Missing Time
posts.description: I haven't been able to write much lately. These past holidays went by quickly, although I strangely managed to enjoy a week in a holiday village in Misano Adriatico, the kind of vacation I would have hated until two years ago. posts.title: New release for the Cycles Trax series
posts.description: Vacation time, hot, so hot in the city, and yet between the end of June and today I made a new set of electronic music tracks, more or less minimal, which I'd consider belonging to the downtempo electronica and ambient techno genres, in a new release for the Cycles Trax series. It is an ongoing series of releases made exclusively using my groovebox and multitrack FM synth, the Elektron Model:Cycle
